title.narrative: Enhancing Gender Equality In and Through Education in West Africa

description.narrative:
This activity will strengthen UNESCO’s support to Member States in West Africa to advance the implementation of the UNESCO Strategy for Gender Equality in and through Education (2026–2029) and accelerate progress towards more gender-responsive education systems.
Despite important gains, significant gender-related barriers continue to affect equitable access to, participation in, and outcomes from education across the region. Addressing these challenges requires strengthened awareness, enhanced institutional capacities, and practical tools to support the systematic integration of gender considerations into education policies, programmes, and practices. Existing UNESCO resources on gender mainstreaming are largely available in English and often lack contextualization to the specific realities and priorities of West African countries.
The project will address this gap through the finalization, validation, and dissemination of a regional gender mainstreaming toolkit tailored to the West African context. Developed in close collaboration with Ministries of Education and key stakeholders, the toolkit will provide practical guidance to support gender-responsive planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation within the education sector. The project will further promote its uptake and use among Ministries of Education and civil society organizations, thereby strengthening national capacities to advance gender equality in and through education across the region.
Ultimately, the project will contribute to strengthening the capacity of education systems in West Africa to identify and address gender-related barriers, creating more inclusive, equitable, and safe learning environments for all learners, particularly girls and young women.
